mainEntity.name: How much does an Audi TT 1.8-2.0 TFSI - 40-45 TFSI engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full rebuilt Audi TT 1.8-2.0 TFSI - 40-45 TFSI engine typically costs between £3,200 and £5,500 for supply only, with reconditioned units starting from £2,000.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of timing chain failure in an Audi TT 1.8-2.0 TFSI - 40-45 TFSI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Early warning signs include a distinct rattling noise from the engine bay on cold starts. You may also experience an illuminated engine management light or a noticeable loss of performance.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in an older Audi TT 1.8-2.0 TFSI - 40-45 TFSI (8J generation)?

acceptedAnswer.text: For 8J models valued between £6,000 and £15,000, a full rebuild is financially viable for well-maintained examples. A reconditioned or rebuilt unit restores reliability and comes with a 12-month warranty.

mainEntity.name: How long does an Audi TT 1.8-2.0 TFSI - 40-45 TFSI engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard supply and fit procedure for the 1.8L or 2.0L TFSI engine typically takes 2 to 3 working days at a specialist workshop.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between the 40 TFSI and 45 TFSI engines in the Audi TT?

acceptedAnswer.text: The 40 TFSI badge typically denotes the 1.8-litre TFSI engine (e.g., CZDA) producing 180hp. The 45 TFSI badge denotes the higher-output 2.0-litre TFSI engine (e.g., CJSB, CHHC) producing 230hp.
